description: HP-13 is the Registration and Licensing Authority (RLA) for the Kandaghat sub-division in Solan district. It operates under the Sub Divisional Officer (Civil) and handles vehicle registration, fitness certificates, and driving license renewals for the local hill region. Kandaghat is a key administrative hub located on the Kalka-Shimla highway.
address: Office of the Sub Divisional Officer (Civil), Kandaghat, District Solan, Himachal Pradesh
